messages:
ash: follow-up from the 02:00am page flood. we need owners + short timelines for alert tuning so this doesn't recur. items: 
- raise noisy infra CPU threshold (owner: priya) target: 72h
- add job-level dedupe for error-rate alerts (owner: noah) target: 7d
- suppression for flapping hosts -> route suppressed to #suppression-review (owner: frank) target: 10d
please ack and call out blockers. tagging @alerts-bot to create a tracker.

priya: ack. i'll bump CPU rule to 0.92 in staging and run a 24h dry-run. will paste rule diff and grafana link.

noah: taking dedupe. will use `dedupe_key: '{{ job }}:{{ error_sig }}'` and open PR by Thu. adding a CI smoke that emits synthetic errors to validate.

frank: I'll prototype suppression: suppress when flap_count >3 in 10m and forward suppressed incidents to #suppression-review; exclude control-plane hosts. need the list.

ash: answers: exclude control-plane hosts (i'll DM the list). priya/noah/frank -- great. @alerts-bot please create ticket.

alerts-bot: Task created: https://tasks.company/INFR-9999 "Alert tuning: cpu thresh, dedupe, suppression" assigned to [priya,noah,frank] due 2026-07-01 :white_check_mark:

noah: will include a smoke CI that fires 10 synthetic errors and asserts dedupe behavior; target next Wed.

priya: will monitor dry-run dashboards and roll back if we see missed capacity.

ash: i'll update the postmortem action table and close the ticket when smoke tests pass. final checklist: priya (72h), noah (7d), frank (10d). flag here for more time. :thumbsup:
